items.question: Is Mariable really free?
items.answer: Yes, all features are accessible for free: checklist, budget, RSVP, seating plan, day-of coordination, vendor guide. Only PDF exports, guides, unlimited AI and unlimited budget require Premium.

items.question: What's included in the €29 Premium account?
items.answer: Premium is a one-time €29 purchase that removes all limitations: unlimited PDF/CSV exports, unlimited AI, unlimited budget, PDF wedding guides, unlimited document storage and priority support.

items.question: Is it a subscription or a one-time payment?
items.answer: It's a one-time €29 payment. No subscription, no automatic renewal. You pay once and keep access for life.

items.question: Can I use the app with my family?
items.answer: Yes, the app is built to be collaborative. Everyone can access the planning and key information thanks to real-time sharing.

items.question: Can I upgrade to Premium later?
items.answer: Yes, you can upgrade to Premium at any time. Your free account is kept and all your data is preserved during the upgrade.
